caption: The drawing depicts a single bird, positioned in profile facing left, located centrally on a plain, off-white background. The bird is rendered in varying shades of brown with lighter tan and yellowish markings scattered on its body, suggesting a speckled feather pattern. The wings and tail are darker brown with subtle texture lines, and the legs and feet are also brown. The beak is short and pointed, and the eye is dark with a lighter outline. There is no additional scenery or objects present, and the signature "Selma Sandler" appears in small, grey letters near the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Toy Turkey
